caption: A magnet swinging on a string over a steel tray dips low on one swing and snaps down onto the tray, stopping dead.

sa.check: A magnet swings on a string over a steel tray.
On one swing the magnet dips low toward the tray.
The magnet snaps down onto the tray.
The magnet stops dead on the tray.
The magnet swings freely before the dip.
The order is swinging, dip, snap, stopped.

pc.expect: The magnet swings freely while high above the tray; it is pulled down only when it comes close to the steel; once on the tray it stays stuck and still.
pc.fail: The magnet is pulled to the tray from high up; or stops in mid-swing far from the tray; or slides about on the tray after landing; or lifts off the tray again with nothing pulling it.

pc.expect: As the magnet comes close it is drawn sharply onto the tray and stops on contact; it does not bounce off.
pc.fail: The magnet bounces off the tray and swings on; or hangs a gap above the tray without touching; or lands on the tray and slides off its edge; or dips close and swings away untouched.

pc.expect: The string hangs taut from its anchor while the magnet swings and goes slack once the magnet is on the tray; the tray stays on the table.
pc.fail: The string stays taut and straight with the magnet on the tray below the anchor's reach; or the string stands rigid in the air; or the tray lifts toward the magnet; or the magnet rises above its anchor.

pc.expect: The swing is an arc about the anchor until the magnet is drawn down; the pull is toward the tray.
pc.fail: The magnet swings in a straight line; or the anchor moves with the magnet; or the magnet is drawn sideways away from the tray; or the swing widens with nothing pushing it.

pc.expect: One magnet on one string and one tray; the magnet stays on the string; nothing sinks into the tray or vanishes.
pc.fail: The magnet detaches from the string in mid-air; or sinks into the tray; or a second magnet appears; or the tray vanishes.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour, the string and the tray stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or the tray changes colour; or the string changes length between swings.

note: Who set the magnet swinging is not judged; the swing already under way is the caption's setup.
